text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder completed her debut race splendidly,
leaving a vivid and lasting impression...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have returned, Trainer.
How are your nerves holding up?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's wonderful to hear~♪
This is the first step... right?

And so, once Grass Wonder had finished getting ready to leave,
we stepped outside...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Grass Wonder-san!
Could we please speak with you for a moment!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes. It's totally fine~.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!!
Well then, here goes...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
What a truly splendid run for a debut race!
It gave us a glimpse of her brilliant potential!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, I am honored by your praise~.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Yes, it was absolutely thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the "Successor to Maruzensky"—
she truly lives up to the name "Monster the Second"!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

"The reporter, speaking with sparkling eyes, seemed to be
overlapping Grass Wonder with Maruzensky far too much."

It probably wasn't a very pleasant experience
for Grass Wonder either...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Leave this to me.

I started to raise my voice,
but Grass Wonder quickly stopped me.

Without noticing how we were reacting,
the excited reporter continued their interview...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what kind of rotation
are you planning for the future!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: If you've decided on your next target race or anything, I'd love to hear it...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Aaah, about that, I was actually just about to consult you on it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And so, Trainer-san. Do you have a moment?
choice_data_list: Is there a race you want to run in?
Is there a race you'd like to enter?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, there's one race I've set my heart on.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"—Please let me run in
the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes."
The Asahi Hai FS—widely known as the race that crowns the Junior-class champion, it would certainly be a fitting next race for her.
Yet in that race...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
What!? The Asahi Hai FS!?
Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Isn't that the race where Maruzensky-san smashed the record back in her Junior years?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: And now Grass Wonder is running in the Asahi Hai FS too?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes~.
Assuming I can get my Trainer's permission, that is.

—If she herself wished to run,
I intended to give my permission
as long as the schedule wasn't unreasonable.
However...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, now things are getting hyped!!
"Will the 'Second Gen' Inherit the Junior Legend Next?!"
Yep, that's our headline!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the valuable conversation!!
Excuse me now!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Please take your time and have a safe trip home~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now then... once more.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is it all right if our next target race
is the Asahi Hai FS~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Meaning...?

In the race known as the Asahi Hai FS,
Maruzensky left a truly vivid and lasting impression.

"If she, already hailed as the 'successor' and 'second coming',
were to run in that race――"
choice_data_list: I'll inevitably be seen as a "second generation"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Which is all the more reason why."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Once the label of 'second-generation' has spread, it will be all but impossible to escape it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However—to begin with,
I have no intention of running away.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let us welcome a head-to-head comparison.
And upon doing so, I shall demonstrate my superiority.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My running, that alone.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And... with that, let me ask you once again.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Would you please give me permission
to enter the Asahi Hai FS~?
choice_data_list: Let's go show them what you can do!
Let's go show them what you can do!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then let's get right to training~♪

And so, our next target race was decided:
the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes!
